result.summary: Tests already exist at tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig. TC-SCH-02-02 (line 526) covers the skip-locked fix — holds FOR UPDATE on timer row in separate connection, verifies skipped_locked > 0. TC-SCH-02-03 (line 627) covers the tx failure surfacing — pre-seeds idempotency_key conflict, expects SchedulerError.TransactionFailed. Both tests directly exercise the fixed code paths. No new test design needed.
